row.evidence: Cube's pricing comparison lists Single Sign-On (SSO) "(Okta, SAML & SCIM)" only in the Enterprise (Custom) column, and the SCIM guides say "Available on Enterprise plan."
row.notes: Cube here is Cube Dev (cube.dev, semantic layer / Cube Cloud), chosen because it documents SCIM; Cube Software (cubesoftware.com, FP&A) lists SAML SSO but no SCIM, and the Okta OIN 'Cube' app is the FP&A product. Self-serve plans are priced per developer seat and billed monthly (Starter $40, Premium $80; Premium also sells Explorer $40 and Viewer $20 seats); no annual price is published. SAML, SCIM and audit logging are Enterprise-only (Custom). SCIM requires SAML to be configured first and is switched on in Admin > Settings > SAML; the SCIM token is a Cube API key. PATCH active=false deactivates (sessions end); DELETE deletes. No Cube catalogue app in Okta/Entra/Google: docs use custom SAML apps with the generic SCIM endpoint.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Explorer seats $40/user/month and Viewer seats $20/user/month on Premium.

auth.token_source: Settings > API Keys (a Cube API key used as the SCIM token); SCIM Provisioning toggle in Admin > Settings > SAML

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivation keeps the account (not permanently removed); SCIM DELETE deletes the user.

custom.how: Cube user attributes via urn:cube:params:1.0:UserAttribute:<reference> (documented for Entra)

roles.how: New SCIM users get the shared SAML default role (Viewer by default); 'Map roles by group' maps pushed group display names to roles, additive only

limitations.text: Group-based role assignment is additive; removing a user from a group does not remove the role.
Admin permissions cannot be assigned through SCIM default role; must be set manually.

endpoints.purpose: Export audit log events as CSV (Enterprise)
Apply DEACTIVATE / ACTIVATE / DELETE to up to 100 users

okta.notes: No Cube Dev app in the OIN (the OIN 'Cube' listing is Cube Software FP&A, SSO only); Cube docs use a custom Okta SAML app with the generic SCIM connector.

entra.notes: Non-gallery enterprise application with the generic SCIM endpoint.

google.notes: Custom SAML app in Google Admin; no provisioning documented.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin is named in the SCIM API description, no OneLogin guide found.
